value.request: Upgrade the web framework across a major version in one autonomous run: apply the codemod, migrate deprecated APIs, repair the tests, and finish with a green suite and an upgrade changelog.
value.context: Synthetic mid-size app where the upgrade requires roughly a dozen dependent migration steps whose later steps only surface after earlier ones land. Measures sustained autonomous execution, not a single edit.

acceptance_checks.spec: The full test suite exits 0 on the upgraded framework version.
No skipped tests, TODO markers, or commented-out migration steps introduced by the run remain.
The run reaches a green suite without human intervention; every stall it recovers from is documented in the changelog.
The upgrade changelog records each migrated API and any behavior-affecting decision.

pairing_rationale: The Fable high/xhigh pair keeps the established effort boundary measurable. The Opus 5 high/xhigh pair runs the fresh successor sweep required by Anthropic's migration guidance, while same-effort comparisons against Fable test whether frontier spend still buys fewer stalls or follow-up corrections on a genuinely long-horizon run.
